title: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:7:0:00007:part:1/1
title_original: 법관의 국제기구 파견 등에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 7 (Return to the Republic of Korea during Secondment)
(1) Where a seconded judge, etc. intends to return to the Republic of Korea during the period of secondment, the judge or official shall obtain prior approval from the Minister of the National Court Administration by submitting the grounds for return and relevant supporting documents: Provided, That in urgent circumstances, the judge or official may obtain oral approval, return to the Republic of Korea, and submit the relevant documents immediately thereafter.
(2) Expenses incurred in returning to the Republic of Korea during the period of secondment shall be borne by the seconded judge, etc.
